Statistics are episode-based. An episode is a continuous span at one stance — from the day the algorithm entered that stance until the day it left. Durations range from a single day to many months. There is no fixed holding window anywhere on this board.

N is the number of completed historical episodes at this strategy and stance — the sample behind every statistic to its right. Rows with fewer than five are greyed. Win/Loss Ratio is blank where no episode at this stance has lost money.

Stance is a plain reading of the allocation, nothing more. The algorithm produces a signal for each strategy and that signal sets how much of the leveraged fund to hold; the band names the result. Defensive is 0%, Cautious is a half position at 50%, and Bullish covers everything else — a full position, or a partial one the algorithm is scaling into. Two strategies in the same band carry the same amount of risk.

Top 3 — Model Portfolio

A model $100,000 book started 2021-07-30, holding up to three strategies at a time. It buys the strongest qualifying candidates, holds them until something clearly better appears, and sits in Treasuries when nothing qualifies. Selection, sizing and every statistic on this page are set out in Page Help.

Open Positions

Sizing follows one rule: three names — 33.3% each, fully invested; two names — 50% each, fully invested; one name — 50% in it and 50% in Treasuries, because the 50% ceiling binds; nothing qualifying — the whole book in Treasuries.
